authority.source_authority: DAD registries and repository contracts retain local source authority; Lowell retains product, automation, external-offload, budget, security, privacy, release, and final decision authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only capability-os-integration-writer edits repository files. Scouts and specialists are read-only, and the independent checker replays evidence without editing writer outputs.

roles.why_needed: One integration owner must preserve compatibility across schemas, registries, graph projections, routing, telemetry, CLI, cockpit, skills, and tests.
roles.mission: Implement the complete phased Capability Operating System and produce deterministic validation evidence.
inputs: existing ML and family portfolio implementation
roles.authority: May edit only this isolated worktree for the accepted build; may not activate external automation, mutate other repositories, install integrations, or authorize release.
acceptance_conditions: One-human cockpit exposes at most three immediate decisions
No producer self-approval or silent mutation path exists
stop_conditions: External mutation or Cursor activation would be required

roles.why_needed: The implementation spans an older live branch and a dirty isolated portfolio worktree that must be reconciled without losing work.
roles.mission: Inventory branch, worktree, registry, module, test, and compatibility evidence and recommend the safest integration sequence.
roles.authority: Read-only inventory; cannot edit, clean, reset, merge, rebase, or commit.
acceptance_conditions: Exact implemented and missing surfaces are listed
Conflicts and ownership risks are explicit
stop_conditions: A destructive Git action appears necessary

readiness_conditions: Both worktrees and relevant histories are inspected

roles.why_needed: A single busy human needs extreme attention efficiency, quiet defaults, bounded decisions, and token-aware offload.
roles.mission: Define one-human cockpit, automation, trigger, token-budget, deterministic batch, and Cursor-style offload acceptance contracts.
roles.authority: Read-only design advice; cannot schedule routines, enable integrations, contact services, or mutate project state.
acceptance_conditions: Quiet batching and snooze semantics are testable
Large simple work routes to deterministic or approved low-cost adapters
stop_conditions: Token efficiency weakens validation or privacy

readiness_conditions: Existing DAD operator surfaces are inspected

roles.why_needed: Every AI, workflow, trigger, and offload route needs explicit decision rights and consequence gates.
roles.mission: Define observe, retrieve, recommend, draft, validate, execute, and prohibited authority with fail-closed human gates and separation of duties.
roles.authority: Read-only governance analysis; cannot grant authority, approve automation, or modify policy.
acceptance_conditions: Consequence tiers and human gates are explicit
Adversarial cases cover privilege escalation and self-approval
stop_conditions: Policy conflict cannot be resolved from source evidence

roles.why_needed: A material governance and routing control plane cannot be accepted by its producer.
roles.mission: Independently replay schemas, routing, telemetry, graph, cockpit, privacy, governance, offload, skill, CLI, and regression acceptance evidence.
roles.authority: Read-only independent review; cannot edit outputs, activate automations, or approve release on behalf of the human.
acceptance_conditions: Every proof obligation has replayed evidence
Failures and residual risks are explicit
stop_conditions: Validation would require an external mutation

proof_obligations.description: Prove all four planes, top-ten portfolio, governance, token-efficient automation, and operator surfaces are implemented.
Prove AI decision rights fail closed and no producer, sentinel, trigger, or offload adapter can self-authorize mutations.
Prove considered, selected, executed, completed, and independently validated evidence remain distinct, private, deduplicated, and revision-aware.
Prove the cockpit requires at most three immediate decisions and supports quiet batching, snooze, defer, drill-down, and compact resume.
Prove existing ML, family, DAD validation, navigation, and repository tests remain compatible.
